title: Metacognitive Steering: Learning the Structure of Scientific Judgment
abstract: arXiv:2609.16245v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon scientific discovery requires agents to alternate between exploration, disciplined execution, and critical reassessment as evidence changes. Current language models are trained primarily on the products of science and optimized using outcome-level signals, providing limited supervision for these process-level shifts in scientific judgment. We investigate whether such judgment can be recovered from scientist interaction traces and used to control the internal computation of a frozen frontier model. Using contrastive interventions collected during real scientific research, we identify a coordinated, low-dimensional control structure within Kimi 2.6, a trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model. Residual analysis, attention-weight subspace alignment, and cross-layer singular value decomposition converge on a mid-depth control surface spanning key layers. translated_title: 元认知引导：学习科学判断的结构
translated_abstract: 长周期的科学发现需要智能体随着证据的变化，在探索、规范执行和批判性重新评估之间灵活切换。当前的语言模型主要在科学成果（产物）上进行训练，并使用结果层面的信号进行优化，因而对这些科学判断的过程级转变提供的监督非常有限。我们研究了这种科学判断能力是否可以从科学家的交互轨迹中恢复，并用于控制一个冻结的前沿模型的内部计算。通过在真实科学研究过程中收集的对比干预数据，我们在Kimi 2.6——一个万亿参数的混合专家模型——中识别出了一个协调的、低维的控制结构。残差分析、注意力权重子空间对齐以及跨层奇异值分解均收敛于一个横跨关键层的中间深度控制面。我们提出了“元认知引导”，这是一种推理时控制器，能够……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究从真实科学家的交互轨迹中成功识别出前沿万亿参数大模型内部协调的低维科学判断控制结构，并提出“元认知引导”推理时控制器，可在不改动模型权重的情况下调控冻结模型的科学判断过程。
en_tdlr: This study recovers the structure of scientific judgment from real scientist interaction traces, identifying a coordinated low-dimensional control structure within a frozen trillion-parameter frontier model, and introduces "Metacognitive Steering," an inference-time controller that regulates the model's scientific judgment.
